verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce is essentially API-first. Its core lifecycle is documented as REST endpoints: card enrollment via POST /acp/v1/tokens, purchase-intent mandates and cancellation via /acp/v1/instructions, and credential retrieval via /instructions/{id}/credentials. An official MCP server also exposes the APIs to agents. However, there is no explicit UI/API parity claim, sandbox onboarding runs through a self-serve web form with Business Center account instructions sent by email, and dispute handling stops at signal capture rather than an API. Missing for 10: a documented parity statement, API-based onboarding/account provisioning, a dispute/refund API, and independent hands-on confirmation that no action is UI-only.
